findings.message: [BR-CL-01]-The document type code MUST be coded by the invoice and credit note related code lists of UNTDID 1001.

[BR-KSA-05]-The invoice type code (BT-3) must be equal to one of value from the subset of UN/CEFACT code list 1001, D.16B agreed for KSA electronic invoices. Please refer paragraph 11.2.1 of XML implementation Standards.
[BR-KSA-19]-Each Document level charge (BG-21) shall have a code for the reason for document level charge (BT-105).
[BR-KSA-69]-A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) 'Zero rated' shall have a VAT exception reason code (BT-121).
